title: option to move/open window to different tag silently?
body:
I don't know if this feature is already implemented but can't find an example in your config.conf.

would you consider having an option to move or open apps/windows silently
without focus following it?

for example, I have an app configured to be opened in tag 5.
when I launch it via app launcher while in tag 1,
I want to stay in focused on tag 1 instead of moving to tag 5.
author: hooxoo

comments.body:
bind=Alt,KP_1,tagsilent,1
windowrule=isopensilent:1,appid:com.obsproject.Studio


you can use this in  the latest commit.

title: Improvement: don't let windows appear on other monitors in scroller layout
body: Currently, in scroller layout, windows can 'overflow' and appear on other monitors. Ideally, windows shouldn't be visible in other monitors even when it's scrolled outside of the current monitor.
author: EdenQwQ

title: Feature: Option to set which layouts to switch_layout
body:
First of all thank you for this awesome project. Loving it so far!

Been going through config setup today and thought it would be more efficient to set which layout styles user would like to cycle through with "switch_layout" instead of cycling through all possible layouts provided by maomaowm.
author: hooxoo
